summary: Iteration 6 verified the public app after the split-payment and frame-precision fixes. Backend regression passed 33/33. UI split flow passed end-to-end: request sent payment_method=cash with two payments, POST succeeded, Bill opened and showed Cash + UPI with Paid status, and persisted session stored payment_method=split with matching payments. Single cash, mismatch rejection, permission revocation, rounding, frozen preview, modal max-height/sticky footer, explicit frame end precision, and running-frame auto-close precision passed.

minor.issue: Auth playbook regression remains: login sets no application access/refresh httpOnly cookies, and six consecutive bad passwords all return 401 without lockout.
Still returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * without credential support instead of an explicit credentialed origin.
Existing admin password is not reconciled with ADMIN_PASSWORD; seed only inserts when missing.

action_items: No blocker remains for split payment or frame precision.
Separately address the pre-existing auth playbook gaps when auth hardening is in scope.
Move Login redirect navigation out of render to eliminate the React setState-during-render console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Sessions.jsx now correctly sends payments[0].method; backend derives and persists split only when multiple positive payment records exist.
Both explicit frame end and end-session auto-close now calculate amount from elapsed seconds/3600; tests observed nonzero short-frame amounts rather than zero or a one-minute charge.
Login.jsx still calls navigate('/dashboard') during render when user is set, reproducing a BrowserRouter/Login console warning.
server.py remains about 1400 lines, above the 700-line maintainability threshold; split auth, sessions, reports, and expense routes into modules.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested split and single-payment E2E flows

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ API/UI sessions and snack orders; all test sessions completed. Staff permissions restored to manage_sessions=true only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 6 blocker is cleared. Final split UI used a frozen ₹50 total, Cash ₹25 + UPI ₹25; modal height was 860.5px at 1920x1080, Bill and backend persistence matched. Backend mismatch format and both frame precision paths are covered in backend_test.py.
rca_of_the_issue: The prior split failure was a frontend/backend contract mismatch: literal payment_method='split' was rejected before payments[] processing. Sending the first concrete method satisfies validation, after which backend derives stored payment_method='split'. Frame undercharging came from truncating elapsed seconds to whole minutes before billing; direct seconds/3600 calculation fixes both explicit end and auto-close.
